purpose.primary: Provide a small formal teaching abstraction for selected algebraic properties associated with the Nawderian SET Theorem.
purpose.formal_goal: Represent three named SET contributions, keep gravity separately supplied, and inspect their additive composition and selected zero-component consequences.
purpose.educational_principle: A formal model can verify consequences of a declared additive decomposition without establishing that the decomposition is a complete empirical description of a physical system.

source_alignment.selected_structure: Named contributions combined into a modeled total with a separately supplied gravitational contribution.
source_alignment.formal_abstraction: Signed integer SETContribution structure plus additive totalContribution.

total.conceptual_form: Gravity + Spin + Field / Charge + Temperature -> Modeled Total

teaching_simplification.purpose: Make named contributions, decomposition, recomposition, zero cases, and single-component changes directly inspectable.
deliberately_not_established: sufficiency of simple addition for every intended application
experimental meaning of the represented numeric values
empirical validity of the broader Nawderian SET interpretation

why_signed_values.purpose: Allow positive, zero, and negative contribution values without introducing additional libraries or physical assumptions.
why_signed_values.boundary: Signed integers are a teaching representation and do not establish that complete physical SET contributions are naturally integer-valued.

subtotal.name: SETContribution.subtotal
subtotal.purpose: Keep the three named SET contributions explicit before gravity is added.

decomposition.principle: The named positions remain visible rather than being hidden inside one unexplained total.

formal_targets.name: Expanded Total
formal_targets.claim: totalContribution gravity s = gravity + s.spin + s.electrolysis + s.temperature
formal_targets.meaning: The modeled total directly exposes all four represented contributions.

formal_targets.name: Total Matches SET Subtotal
formal_targets.meaning: The expanded total agrees with adding gravity to the separately defined SET subtotal.

formal_targets.name: Zero Temperature Contribution
formal_targets.claim: When temperature is zero, the modeled total reduces to gravity + spin + electrolysis.
formal_targets.meaning: A neutral temperature contribution disappears algebraically while the remaining positions remain visible.

formal_targets.name: All SET Contributions Neutral
formal_targets.claim: When spin, electrolysis, and temperature are all zero, the modeled total reduces to gravity.
formal_targets.meaning: With all three SET contributions neutral, only the separately supplied gravitational contribution remains.

total_expands.formal_expression: totalContribution gravity s = gravity + s.spin + s.electrolysis + s.temperature
total_expands.lesson: Each named formal field corresponds to one visible term in the represented total.

total_matches_subtotal.lesson: The separately defined subtotal and expanded total agree under the supplied additive definitions.

zero_temperature.lesson: Setting one contribution to zero changes the total without removing the remaining structural positions.

zero_set_reduces_to_gravity.lesson: When every represented SET contribution is neutral, the separately supplied gravity contribution remains.

concrete_example.purpose: Give the learner a concrete decomposition whose result can be predicted before formal reduction.

change_propagation.formal_relationship: Under the supplied additive model, increasing the represented temperature contribution from 4 to 7 changes the represented total from 15 to 18 while the other represented contributions remain fixed.

awareness.question: What contributions have actually been declared?

alignment.question: Which mathematical term corresponds to which proposed contribution?
alignment.formal_answer: Each named contribution occupies an explicit term in the represented additive total.

coherence.question: Does the total follow from the supplied composition rule?
coherence.formal_answer: The expanded total agrees with gravity plus the declared SET subtotal under the supplied definitions.

clarity.question: Can the contributions be inspected separately?
clarity.formal_answer: Yes. Gravity, spin, electrolysis, and temperature remain explicit named positions.

continuity.question: What happens when one contribution changes while the others remain fixed?
continuity.formal_answer: The corresponding represented value and total change while the other named contribution positions and additive relation remain stable.

inspect: Which physical interpretations are not encoded by the type?
formal_awareness.principle: Nothing in the SETContribution type itself establishes that the represented integers describe nature.

formal_alignment.principle: Each source contribution selected for the teaching abstraction has a visible formal partner.
